title: docs(skills): retirement kit routes a RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR entry through entries/retired-keys/ and gen:migration-registry, and an enum-value narrowing through enumWithRetiredValues()
body:
Fixes #20803

Clause-②: no

Dispatched by the `domain:skills` seat 1 (seat post #7623) under the PM claim 5907960440, session `session_01KTZmMfzVzjNvyaLyQ8mHvg`, branch `claude/issue-20803-retirement-kit-registry-entries`. This is a draft. The file is on a governed surface (`.claude/**`, Tier S in the `GOVERNED_SURFACES` register), so the seat lands it after an at-tier contract review.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么**:退役技能包 `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` 的两段文字。§3 把「退役键登记」改成在 `entries/retired-keys/` 加一个文件、再跑 `gen:migration-registry`;§2 的枚举值退役改指现成的 `enumWithRetiredValues()`,不再教手写 `error` map。文件行数不变(337/337)。
- **为什么改**:登记表 `registry.ts` 早已改为由 `entries/` 逐文件生成,旧文字却让照做的 agent 往生成区手打,`check:migration-registry` 必红、白费一轮;枚举值退役已有通用 helper,旧文字仍在教旧的手写形状。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯文字改动,零运行时影响,不发布任何包。回滚即 revert 本 PR。它与 #20809(门 (b) 打印的补救文案)须说同一条路线:本 PR 先落,#20809 引用本文。
- **席位意见**:
- **你要做的**:无。本 PR 属 Tier S,由席位达档复核 PASS 后入队落地。

## What changed

One file, `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md`, two texts, net 0 lines (337 before and after; ceiling 337). The landing site is the one the claim named. The measurement found no other producer of the wrong text inside `.claude/**`.

**Text 1: §3, the `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR` checklist item.** It sent the entry to be typed into `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`, and it said the gate's failure output prints "the line to paste". That table is now generated: it is concatenated from one file per entry, and the generator reverts a hand edit between the markers, which `check:migration-registry` reports first. The item now says what an author actually does:

- add one file under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/retired-keys/`, named as `entries/README.md` says. The kit does not restate the naming convention.
- run `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:migration-registry`, which generates the entry into `registry.ts`. Never type the entry there.

Kept unchanged:

- the literal `'DEFKEY:NAME'` value, spelled as `authorable-surface/CATEGORY.json` spells it (minus `[RETIRED]`), filed under the current major;
- gate (b) reads it by exact set membership, with no inference;
- the (b2) warning: do not add the entry before the tombstone lands;
- the "why a second table" note and the aging-clock note.

Two lines of the old item are byte-identical in the new one: the `authorable-surface/…` line and the (b2) tail line.

Deleted: "the gate's failure output prints the line to paste". That sentence named the paste route this card retires, and what gate (b) prints is #20809's to change. The new text is true both before and after #20809 lands, because it names the file route and never quotes the gate's current wording as the thing to follow.

**Text 3: §2, the enum-value paragraph.** It prescribed a hand-rolled enum `error` map dispatched on `issue.input`, citing `HookBodyCapability` (`data/hook-body.zod.ts`) and the `object.managedBy: 'system'` precedent. It now points at `enumWithRetiredValues()` in `shared/retired-key.ts`: declare the retired members and their prescriptions there, with no hand-written `error` map.

Kept: an enum-value narrowing is invisible to the four ratchets, and none of the three key routes applies to it.

Deleted: the two hand-rolled citations. Offered as the shape to copy, they now point at the wrong route. They also have another home: the helper's own docblock (`retired-key.ts`, "The gap this closes") names both as the hand-rolled precursors of the helper.

## Measured before writing (`origin/main` at `79114850`)

- **The registry is generated.** `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts:19-26` says the three tables are GENERATED from `./entries/`, one file per entry, "never by typing between the markers. See `./entries/README.md`." There are 237 files under `entries/retired-keys/`.
- **The README owns the route.** `entries/README.md` "Adding an entry" gives the file-name rule and the `gen:migration-registry` command. Its "Four rules" say that the next `gen:` run reverts a hand edit inside the markers, and that `check:migration-registry` (`tsx scripts/build-migration-registry.ts --self-test --check`) reports it before that.
- **The helper has no production caller.** `HookBodyCapability` (`data/hook-body.zod.ts:48-60`) and `object.managedBy` (`data/object.zod.ts:1705-1710`) are still hand-rolled `z.enum(values, { error })` maps. `enumWithRetiredValues()` has 0 non-test call sites. `git grep` outside `*.test.ts` finds only its definition and docblock in `retired-key.ts`, and one test file uses it (`shared/retired-key.test.ts`).
- **The helper covers every retirement the hand-rolled map covers.** Both hand-rolled sites answer one exact retired string with a prescription and leave every other value to zod, which is exactly the helper's `retired` map. The helper's docblock names one case it does not cover: a retired member that WAS the default. A hand-rolled map cannot cover that case either, because the default must be a live member. The docblock routes that case to `acceptRetiredDefaultResidue`. So the kit says "don't hand-roll" with no exception, and stays true.
- **No other sentence sends an entry into `registry.ts`.** The census covered `.claude/**`, `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md`, grepping for `migrations/registry`, `registry.ts`, `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR`, `RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR`, `copy these lines` and `粘贴`, plus paste/append near registry. It found two `registry.ts` hits, both in the kit:
  - the text-1 line, fixed here;
  - the step-18 D3-chain item. That item is true and stays untouched: a `MIGRATIONS_BY_MAJOR` step's `rationale` and `conversionIds` are hand-written outside the generated markers (`registry.ts:37-42`; `STEP18_RATIONALE` at `:5024`).

  The kit's D3 `semantic` item already routes through `entries/`, and nothing outside the kit matched.

## One route, said once in each place (with #20809)

At this head, #20809 has no branch or PR, so this lands first. Under the triage split the second to land quotes the first, so gate (b)'s printed remedy should name the same directory and command:

- directory: `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/retired-keys/`, with the file name per `entries/README.md`;
- command: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:migration-registry`.

#20809 remains open. This PR touches nothing under `packages/spec/**`.

## Acceptance notes

- **A sibling of gate (b), same family as #20809.** `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas.ts:2636-2640` is the def-removal gate. It prints the same "copy these lines in … under `18: [ … ]`" remedy for `RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR`, whose table is generated from `entries/retired-defs/`. #20809 lists only gate (b) (`:1127-1128`), so its author may want to take this sibling in the same edit. Both hand-rolled precursors work as they are; this is an observation, not a defect. Carrier: none.
